comment: Registry of soak-tracked metrics. Adding a metric is data, not code: emit a SOAK_METRIC line from the integration harness and declare it here. The collector, the weekly/nightly aggregation, the dashboard charts and the gate all read this file.

gate_policies.track: Record and chart only. Never fails or warns on week-over-week movement. Use until enough history exists to set a defensible threshold. A max_abs ceiling, if set, still applies as a runaway guard.
gate_policies.warn: Emit a warning on regression beyond the threshold; does not fail the soak.
gate_policies.gate: Fail the soak on regression beyond the threshold.

metrics.label: LFB convergence spread
metrics.description: Max minus min last-finalized-block number across all shard nodes, sampled at the end of each steady-state load phase. Measures whether nodes agree on finalized state, which is distinct from tip-LFB lag (how far finalization trails the DAG tip).

gate.max_abs_rationale: Runaway guard, deliberately generous — NOT a tuned threshold. test_load.py asserts spread <= 5 at a single quiescent post-drain point; mid-load spread is legitimately wider, and nobody has measured that distribution yet. A spread this large means nodes disagree on finalized state outright rather than one lagging slightly. Re-set from observed data once several weeks of history exist, then move policy to warn and later gate.
